input: Search all .js files under /src for the string 'console.log'. Replace every occurrence with 'logger.info' in-place. Print each modified filename and how many replacements were made per file. At the end, print 'Files modified: N' with the total count of files changed.

transcript.final_response:
All occurrences replaced:

- `/src/app.js: 1 replacements`
- `/src/index.js: 2 replacements`
- `/src/middleware.js: 2 replacements`
- `Files modified: 3`

Verified – no `console.log` remains in `/src/*.js`, all replaced with `logger.info`.
tool_calls: grep -rn 'console\.log' /src --include="*.js" 2>&1; echo "EXIT:$?"; echo "---FILE CONTENTS---"; for f in /src/*.js /src/**/*.js; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "== $f ==" && cat "$f" && echo; done

modified=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  count=$(grep -o 'console\.log' "$file" | wc -l)
  if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
    sed -i 's/console\.log/logger.info/g' "$file"
    echo "$file: $count replacements"
    modified=$((modified+1))
  fi
done < <(find /src -type f -name '*.js' -print0)
echo "Files modified: $modified"

find /src -type f -name '*.js'; echo "exit:$?"
ls -la /src/
grep -r 'console.log' /src --include="*.js" | cat

bash -c '
modified=0
for file in $(find /src -type f -name "*.js"); do
  count=$(grep -o "console\.log" "$file" | wc -l)
  # trim spaces
  count=$(echo "$count" | tr -d " ")
  if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
    sed -i "s/console\.log/logger.info/g" "$file"
    echo "$file: $count replacements"
    modified=$((modified+1))
  fi
done
echo "Files modified: $modified"
'
echo "---verify---"
grep -rn 'console\.log\|logger\.info' /src --include="*.js"
